title: Ask an agent to reply to a comment now

steps.waitFor: h1:has-text("Keep chats when a window reloads")

steps.type: Should a reload also reopen the chats that were closed?

steps.caption: Comment and Ask an Agent (Ctrl+Shift+Enter): an agent answers it now
Its implementer, Vega-2, is busy: the comment waits for its turn to end
Answer Now: a separate agent answers instead
It's thinking, with the time since it started, and Stop
Its answer shows as a reply to the comment; Retry asks for a new one
